allow_instructions: Read-only git and file inspection in this repo is fine.
Backend checks from the repo root are fine: gofmt, go vet, go test, go build.
Frontend checks from frontend/ are fine: npm run format, lint, typecheck, test, build.
block_instructions: Do not auto-run git push, git reset, git rebase, git checkout, or --force git.
Do not auto-run database migrations or anything that uses DATABASE_URL against a non-local database.
Do not auto-run npm install or go get that changes lockfiles without approval.
